title: Dordrecht unlawful data processing: date is 18 November, period 2018-2025
what_changed: ANP (Binnenlands Bestuur) reported the municipality's press release on 18 November, a day before Security.nl, so the date moves from 19 to 18 November. Added that the data were processed and shared between 2018 and 2025 and that an independent investigation started after a complaint found the processing unlawful on several points.
